text: ha. ok. i see the elevator. how does it work. i can at least get into this elevator so much better start
resolution: Answered in-session: the elevator is one 3m storey piece; stack pieces to grow the shaft (each storey IS a stop, grid snap stacks on the top face, R rotates the open doorway face). In F1 test mode walk onto the car and E rides up one stop per press (wrapping down from the top); stand at a landing and E calls the car. Ride speed is the 'elevator speed m/s' knob in build-placed tuning; car height is live route state (parks at the bottom on reload). Door/window wall types live in the Wall palette tab and edge-snap like plain walls.
